WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE E.S.INDIRESH  ORAL ORDER 1.

In this writ petition, the petitioner has sought for a writ of mandamus directing the respondent Nos.1 and 2 to consider the petition filed by the petitioner, dated 07.08.2023, under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, as per Annexure-F, whereby the petitioner has sought for modification of the Award dated 13.03.2023 passed by the Land Acquisition Officer, in respect of the subject land.
NC: 2024:KHC:45581 2.

sentences.text: The petitioner has stated that he has filed detailed objection in so far as acquisition proceedings initiated by the respondent - authorities is concerned and same has not been considered by the respondent - authorities.

3. In that view of the matter, respondent Nos.1 and 2 herein are directed to consider the petition filed by the petitioner as per Annexure-F, if not already considered till date, within six months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and result of the same be made known to the petitioner.
4.
Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of.
